extensions.name: AI
extensions.recommendation: Option-D opens Claude and Option–Shift–D opens Codex. Use Raycast AI through aliases, favorites, or the optional number-row shortcuts; AI does not take the app letters.

extensions.name: Apple Shortcuts
extensions.recommendation: All five installed Apple Shortcuts use k plus a two-letter mnemonic, saved and verified on 19 October. No Shortcut was executed during alias setup.

extensions.name: Applications
extensions.recommendation: Option and Option–Shift both launch apps, paired by letter. S groups Zen, Chrome and Edge; Enter follows the configured default browser.

extensions.name: Browser
extensions.recommendation: Keep only if you use Raycast's browser integration; setup is an occasional action.

extensions.name: Calculator
extensions.recommendation: Use root search for calculations; history is useful for retrieval.

extensions.name: Calendar
extensions.recommendation: Useful for joining calls without opening Calendar.

extensions.name: Clipboard History
extensions.recommendation: High priority. Current alias clip is longer than requested.

extensions.name: Contacts
extensions.recommendation: Occasional command; no dedicated global key needed.

extensions.name: Developer
extensions.recommendation: These are Raycast extension-development commands, not general code tools.

extensions.name: Dictation
extensions.recommendation: Keep double-tap Left Option for Dictate. Dictate to Note uses alias dn or a favorite. No single Option tap is assigned.

extensions.name: Dictionary
extensions.recommendation: Simple occasional lookup.

extensions.name: Emoji & Symbols
extensions.recommendation: Prefer one emoji search provider.

extensions.name: File Search
extensions.recommendation: High priority. Current file alias becomes fs.

extensions.name: MCP
extensions.recommendation: Administration commands are occasional; no global app-launch shortcut needed.

extensions.name: Navigation
extensions.recommendation: Useful for unfamiliar app menus and multiwindow work.

extensions.name: Quicklinks
extensions.recommendation: Category leader plus two or three mnemonic characters; aliases saved and verified 19 October. Existing hotkeys preserved.

extensions.name: Raycast
extensions.recommendation: Keep administrative commands searchable; export before changing the setup.

extensions.name: Raycast Focus
extensions.recommendation: Choose this or Session/Pomodoro as your primary focus system.

extensions.name: Raycast for Teams
extensions.recommendation: Low priority unless you administer a Raycast organization. Five organization/webhook commands were reviewed.

extensions.name: Raycast Notes
extensions.recommendation: Use for disposable notes while Obsidian remains the long-term store.

extensions.name: Raycast Settings
extensions.recommendation: Shortcuts is the main configuration destination.

extensions.name: Screen Awareness
extensions.recommendation: Category leader plus two or three mnemonic characters; aliases saved and verified 19 October. Existing hotkeys preserved.

extensions.name: Screenshots
extensions.recommendation: Useful retrieval; CleanShot remains the capture tool.

extensions.name: Script Commands
extensions.recommendation: The dynamic browser command is implemented in ~/.dotfiles/raycast/.config/raycast/scripts/open-default-browser.sh and this directory is registered in Raycast. Command-Enter was saved and verified in Settings on 17 October. The db alias is saved and verified.

extensions.name: Snippets
extensions.recommendation: Category leader plus two or three mnemonic characters; aliases saved and verified 19 October. Existing hotkeys preserved.

extensions.name: System Actions
extensions.recommendation: Favorite useful navigation only. Keep bulk quit, restart, shutdown and Empty Trash off the frequent-access layer.

extensions.name: System Settings
extensions.recommendation: Keep most preference panes searchable by name.

extensions.name: Translator
extensions.recommendation: Prefer this OR Google Translate as the primary translation command.

extensions.name: Typing Practice
extensions.recommendation: Optional; low relevance to everyday development.

extensions.name: 1Password
extensions.recommendation: Keep search and generation close; the app already has alias 1p.

extensions.name: App Cleaner
extensions.recommendation: Overlaps Applications, Mole and CleanMyMac. Pick one uninstall workflow; leave this unaliased if unused.

extensions.name: Brew
extensions.recommendation: High priority for development maintenance. Existing short aliases can remain.

extensions.name: Clean Keyboard
extensions.recommendation: Occasional physical keyboard cleaning; current cleank is too long.

extensions.name: CleanShot X
extensions.recommendation: Primary screenshot/OCR tool; do not also add duplicate native capture favorites.

extensions.name: Coffee
extensions.recommendation: Use a timed session for long builds and downloads.

extensions.name: Color Picker
extensions.recommendation: Useful for frontend and design work.

extensions.name: Downloads Manager
extensions.recommendation: Useful for artifacts and installers. Skip Delete Latest Download on the frequent-access layer.

extensions.name: Emoji Search
extensions.recommendation: Duplicates Emoji & Symbols. Prefer emo on the built-in provider; leave this searchable if needed.

extensions.name: Ghostty
extensions.recommendation: High value; terminal workspace and tab search complement the app-launch key.

extensions.name: GitHub
extensions.recommendation: High priority if this account is used for work. Installed does not prove authentication.

extensions.name: Google Chrome
extensions.recommendation: The installed browser is Canary. Verify the extension targets Canary before relying on its tab/bookmark commands.

extensions.name: Google Translate
extensions.recommendation: Optional alternative to the built-in Translator.

extensions.name: Google Workspace
extensions.recommendation: Useful document creation and Drive search without launching Office.

extensions.name: Kill Process
extensions.recommendation: Useful for hung dev tools. Keep it searchable; do not attach an easy accidental direct action key.

extensions.name: Linear
extensions.recommendation: High priority if you use Linear. Installed does not prove the extension is connected.

extensions.name: Messages
extensions.recommendation: Keep OTP retrieval as an alias rather than spending an app-launch letter.

extensions.name: Mole
extensions.recommendation: Several cleanup/uninstall commands overlap other tools. Analyze Disk is the useful inspection entry; do not favorite cleanup/purge commands.

extensions.name: Pomodoro
extensions.recommendation: Use only if it is your chosen focus system; otherwise Session and Raycast Focus already cover this.

extensions.name: Raycast Explorer
extensions.recommendation: Discovery commands are occasional; leave them searchable. Six commands reviewed.

extensions.name: Safari
extensions.recommendation: Useful secondary browser; keep aliases separate from Canary.

extensions.name: Set Audio Device
extensions.recommendation: Useful for calls and dictation. Choose devices interactively rather than forcing a device without need.

extensions.name: Slack
extensions.recommendation: Extension exists but no Slack desktop app was found in the app inventory. Use extension commands if your workspace is connected.

extensions.name: Speedtest
extensions.recommendation: Useful diagnostics; current spdt becomes spd.

extensions.name: System Monitor
extensions.recommendation: Useful when builds or agents slow the machine.

extensions.name: Tailscale
extensions.recommendation: Useful remote-development diagnostics; preserve deliberate connection changes.

extensions.name: Video Downloader
extensions.recommendation: Occasional, leave out of favorites.

extensions.name: YouTube
extensions.recommendation: Occasional; no development-layer hotkey needed.
